_source.mechanism: MediaWiki Action API: list=categorymembers then prop=imageinfo with iiprop=extmetadata
_source.licence: Per file. Commons hosts many licences; there is no single dataset licence.
_source.attribution: Per file, generated from the stored creator and licence.
_source.note: Rights metadata is taken from each file's own extmetadata block. No HTML page was scraped and no article prose was copied.
_source.rateLimiting: The anonymous Action API returns HTTP 429 on bursts. Requests are serialised with ~1.2s between calls and exponential backoff on 429.
